rows: Severe thunderstorm winds knocked over trees and blew down power lines down east of Hondo.

As the severe thunderstorms continued eastward across central Medina County, they produced additional severe winds that struck the town of Castroville and continued just east of Castroville. Damage was reported near the Castroville Airport as trees and power lines were blown down…
